definitions.explanation: Grass grown or gathered for feeding livestock such as cattle, horses, and sheep. Includes both fresh pasture grass and dried hay.

examples.japanese: ⟦{牛|うし}→牛：01857_ushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{牧草|ぼくそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べている→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: The cows are eating pasture grass.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{備|そな}えて→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧{牧草|ぼくそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{刈|か}り{取|と}った→刈り取る：21025_karitoru⟧。
examples.english: We cut the hay in preparation for winter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{北海道|ほっかいどう}→北海道：11010_hokkaidou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{広大|こうだい}→広大：11328_koudai⟧な{牧草地|ぼくそうち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がり→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧、⟦{丸|まる}く→丸い：02967_marui⟧⟦{巻|ま}かれた→巻く：02418_maku⟧{牧草|ぼくそう}⟦ロール→ロール：11709_rooru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧⟦{風景|ふうけい}→風景：03591_fuukei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}られる→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: In Hokkaido, vast grasslands stretch out, and you can see the scenery of round hay bales lined up.

notes:
A compound of {牧|ぼく} (pasture; grazing) and {草|そう} (grass). An essential term in agriculture and animal husbandry. In Japan, ⟦{北海道|ほっかいどう}→北海道：11010_hokkaidou⟧ is the primary region for dairy farming and livestock grazing, making {牧草|ぼくそう} a familiar sight there.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {牧草地|ぼくそうち}: pastureland; grassland
- {牧草|ぼくそう}⟦ロール→ロール：11709_rooru⟧: hay bale; hay roll
- {牧草|ぼくそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{刈|か}る→刈る：02043_karu⟧: to mow/cut hay
- {牧草|ぼくそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}える→与える：01821_ataeru⟧: to feed hay (to livestock)
- ⟦{乾燥|かんそう}→乾燥：00184_kansou⟧{牧草|ぼくそう}: dried hay

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{干|ほ}し{草|くさ}→干し草：26957_hoshikusa⟧: hay — dried grass; more colloquial term
- ⟦{飼料|しりょう}→飼料：19666_shiryou⟧: feed; fodder — broader term covering all types of animal feed, not just grass
- ⟦{芝生|しばふ}→芝生：03196_shibafu⟧: lawn; turf — cultivated grass for ornamental or recreational use, not for feeding
